evals.name: Deterministic 5-Minute Developer Quick Start README
evals.prompt: Author a root README.md for a backend service providing prerequisites, one-command Docker Compose setup, frozen dependency install, database migrations, and verification health curl.
evals.expected_output: Creates README.md with prerequisites, step-by-step quick start using docker compose up, and curl health check verification.
assertions: Includes a clear single-sentence summary of the service domain responsibilities
Declares explicit runtime prerequisites including Docker Compose and package manager
Outlines deterministic quick start instructions runnable within 5 minutes
Provides an explicit verification step using the readiness health endpoint

evals.name: Six-Pillar Technical Runbook Suite Setup
evals.prompt: Structure a docs/ directory covering the six mandatory architectural runbooks: architecture.md, development.md, testing.md, deployment.md, database.md, and troubleshooting.md.
evals.expected_output: Scaffolds docs/ folder with 6 pillar runbooks including architecture design, dev guides, and incident troubleshooting.
assertions: Creates structured docs/ directory containing all six technical runbooks
Documents Clean Architecture layer topology and external system dependencies
Provides actionable production incident response and troubleshooting playbooks
Links technical runbooks directly from the main project README

evals.name: Declarative Mermaid Diagramming & Changelog Governance
evals.prompt: Embed a version-controlled Mermaid diagram in architecture.md illustrating system data flow, and initialize CHANGELOG.md adhering to the Keep a Changelog standard.
evals.expected_output: Adds Mermaid graph TD to architecture.md and initializes CHANGELOG.md with Added, Changed, and Fixed sections.
assertions: Embeds declarative Mermaid.js diagrams directly within markdown documentation
Avoids unversioned binary images or external links for core system diagrams
Initializes root CHANGELOG.md adhering to the Keep a Changelog standard
Groups release modifications under standard semantic category headers
